items.title: Compiling Rust to readable C with Eurydice
items.summary: 📝 Since then, several projects, including Mutabah's Rust Compiler (mrustc), GCC's Rust support (gccrs), rust_codegen_gcc, and Cranelift have made enormous progress on diversifying Rust's compiler implementations. The most recent such project, Eurydice, has a more ambitious goal: converting Rust code to clean C code. Unlike other compilers, however, Eurydice is concerned with preserving the overall structure of the code while removing constructs that exist in Rust but not in C.🔗 Read more: https://lwn.net/Articles/1055211/

items.title: Rewriting Prime Agent in Rust
items.summary: 📝 Rewriting Prime Agent in Rust Since we launched Prime Agent [1] in August, it has been downloaded more than 300,000 times and has processed over 8 trillion tokens.
